notes.title: Hello everyone! My new game, Nature Atelier, is officially released today
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! My new game, Nature Atelier, is officially released today! This is a decorative design game where you can create unique puzzles using various natural specimens. Unlike traditional puzzle games, there are no rules or restrictions here. You can freely choose the patterns you want to work on and the materials for your puzzles, letting your imagination run wild. Feel free to add it to your wishlist if you're interested—thank you for your support!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282200/Nature_Atelier/?curator_clanid=44786890

notes.title: Numbered Tile Feature
notes.notes: Added a functionality in settings to assign numbers to puzzle pieces, facilitating multiplayer gameplay. Users can opt to enable or disable this feature at their discretion.

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.notes:
Major Update!
Several game enhancements have been made:
1. Added a new gameplay mode and multiple levels.
2. Introduced a toggle switch for puzzle mode that displays puzzle board outlines. Enabling this option significantly reduces puzzle difficulty.
3. The hint feature can now be individually toggled.
4. Interact with cats on the cover and after completing levels.
5. Improved the game interface.
6. Fixed various issues.

notes.title: Game Update Plan
notes.notes:
Based on feedback, we plan to update our game as follows:

1. Add outlines to the base of each level's puzzle to reduce difficulty, with an option to turn the outlines on or off.
2. Introduce a toggle for the hint feature, allowing players to choose whether to enable or disable it.
3. Add new puzzle gameplay and levels.
4. Introduce new puzzle patterns and levels.

These updates are in progress and are expected to be released in the middle to late this month. Stay tuned for updates.

notes.title: "Cats Huddled Together" – the game is officially released now!
notes.notes: If you encounter any issues in the game, I hope you can let me know, and I will resolve them as soon as possible. If you have any suggestions for the game, feel free to leave a comment so we can discuss them together. Thank you all, and I wish you a pleasant gaming experience!
